rubric.role_summary: Electrical hardware developer working on smart-transportation products, including PCB design, hardware validation, in-life product updates, and manufacturing test fixtures.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Electrical hardware developer working on smart-transportation products, including PCB design, hardware validation, in-life product updates, and manufacturing test fixtures.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience designing electronics using modern CAD tools; no particular named CAD tool is required.
- Experience debugging and validating PCBs with standard lab equipment.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience designing multilayer circuit boards, high-speed digital interfaces, switch-mode power supplies, or microprocessor-based products.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Kitchener area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

must_haves.requirement: Experience designing electronics using modern CAD tools; no particular named CAD tool is required.
must_haves.source_quote: You are experienced in designing electronics using modern CAD tools. (Altium Designer and Arena PLM are our jams, but experience with Cadence, KiCad, or Eagle works too!).

must_haves.requirement: Experience debugging and validating PCBs with standard lab equipment.
must_haves.source_quote: You are completely in your element debugging and validating PCBs with standard lab equipment—oscilloscopes, multimeters, and soldering irons are your trusted tools.

preferences.requirement: Experience designing multilayer circuit boards, high-speed digital interfaces, switch-mode power supplies, or microprocessor-based products.
preferences.source_quote: You bring extra horsepower if you have experience designing multilayer circuit boards, high-speed digital interfaces (PCIe, USB3), switch-mode power supplies, or microprocessor-based products.

location.requirement_text: Location: Greater Kitchener area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Data-driven approach and willingness to investigate technical details and root causes.
Comfort using modern AI tools for research, analysis, and engineering tool development.
Ability to collaborate across disciplines, in person and virtually, and exchange constructive feedback.

location.reason: Already one location rule; requirement text restated in the single-location form.
